description:
MoviBot is a movie discovery agent for complex, mixed-constraint queries that combine structured facts (year, studio, runtime, genre) with fuzzy, subjective conditions ("no deaths", "not scary", "safe for a toddler") that no catalog column can pre-encode. Instead of a single fixed-K RAG pass, MoviBot runs a ReAct loop: it plans which tool to use next, narrows candidates with structured filtering and thematic plot search, then reasons per-candidate over deeper story text to verify the subjective constraints, before producing a final, exhaustive answer.

What it CAN do: combine structured filters (year/studio/runtime/genre) with semantic plot search; verify subjective, per-title constraints (e.g. character deaths, tone, scary content) by reasoning over each candidate's story rather than relying on a pre-built column; return an exhaustive, evidence-backed list rather than a fixed top-K guess.

What it CANNOT do (constraints): it only reasons over the movies present in its catalog (a curated subset, not the full IMDb/TMDB corpus); it does not stream or play any content; and for out-of-scope requests (non-movie questions, requests for pirated content, etc.) it returns a short refusal instead of a fabricated answer.
purpose: Let users find the exact movie that fits both their hard constraints and their fuzzy, personal ones, with an exhaustive and verifiable answer instead of a passive or incomplete recommendation.

prompt_template.template: Query: <your movie request in natural language, combining any of: structured constraints (year range, studio, genre, runtime) and subjective constraints (mood, tone, content to avoid, audience e.g. 'safe for a toddler'). Ask to 'be exhaustive' if you want the full matching set rather than a few suggestions.>
prompt_template.example: Query: Find Pixar movies from the last 10 years that are lighthearted and don't have any major character deaths.

prompt_examples.prompt: Bring me all not-too-old (1990+) Disney movies with no deaths, that involve animals, for my 3 year old kid. Please be exhaustive - don't miss a single movie.
